meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill for omo-senpi. Self-orchestrates a 5-member hostile team (categories unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via the native lead team tools for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the insights that survive the attacks, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled bundle to a planner task (load_skills ulw-plan) for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用对抗式辩论打磨规划方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果您的规划需要暴露隐藏的弱点并提升严谨性
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your planning needs rigorous critique to surface hidden flaws

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先宣告 HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!，然后扮演主持人，组建一支由5个不同角色组成的敌对团队，让成员互相攻击方案；只保留经得住攻击的见解，最后强制交给规划器产出可执行计划。
howto.when: 当你提到 “hyperplan”、“hpp”、“adversarial plan” 等触发词，或要求做对抗/敌意式规划时；也用于需要最严格规划、暴露弱假设、盲点和过度工程的场合。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 规划一下这个新功能的上线方案。
say.note: 会启动5人敌对辩论再交规划器。

say.text: 请以 adversarial plan 的方式制定项目计划。
say.note: Claude 将组建批评团队并筛选出最稳的见解。

say.text: hpp 模式，批判性地评估我们的迁移计划。
say.note: 触发交叉批评，保留经过攻击的结论。

howto.what_en: Claude announces 'HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!', leads a 5-agent hostile debate team, keeps only insights that survive the attacks, then hands them to a planner task to produce a concrete plan.
howto.when_en: Triggers on keywords like 'hyperplan', 'hpp', 'adversarial plan', or when you ask for adversarial/hostile planning; also when maximum-rigor planning is needed.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to plan the launch of this new feature.

say_en.text: Please create the project plan using adversarial plan mode.
say_en.note: Claude assembles a critique team, keeps surviving insights.
